description: A tabbed interface component built on Radix UI Tabs. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations with full keyboard navigation following the WAI-ARIA Tabs pattern.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the first tab
Moves focus to the last tab
Moves focus into/out of the tab panel content

focus.notes: Tab triggers receive focus via arrow keys (roving tabindex). Only the active tab is in the Tab order — pressing Tab moves into the tab panel. Focus-visible ring shown on the active trigger.

announcements: Each trigger announces its label and "tab" role
The tablist announces its role and orientation
Tab panels are associated with their triggers via aria-labelledby
Active state is announced via aria-selected
screenReader.notes: Radix automatically manages aria-selected, aria-controls, and aria-labelledby associations between triggers and panels.

contrast.text: Active and inactive tab text meet WCAG AA
contrast.ui: Active indicator (underline in line variant) meets 3:1

motion.reducedMotion: No transition animations on tab switch

consumerResponsibilities: Use descriptive tab labels that make sense out of visual context
Ensure tab panel content is meaningful when tab label is announced
For the line variant, the underline indicator conveys active state visually — screen readers use aria-selected
